blocks.h2: What to Do During a Sewer Backup

steps.body: Every sink, shower, toilet and appliance drains to the same line.
Stay out of water near outlets and appliances.
Tell us where the water is coming up.

tiles.body: Especially under older homes and big trees.
Water pushes back to the lowest drain in the house.
Old clay can crack and settle until flow stops.
Even a newer line clogs when they build up.

blocks.intro: In June 2021, a storm sent water bubbling more than 5 feet out of a sewer in northeast Hinsdale, and one homeowner had about 3 feet of water in a basement that had never flooded before.

items.body: Many historic homes have basements well below the street sewer, so the floor drain is the first place water appears.
Newer homes and renovations often have finished basements with bathrooms, media rooms and bars.
A clean line, a backflow valve and an [overhead sewer system](/hinsdale/overhead-sewer-systems) each solve part of the problem.

blocks.h2: Sewer Backup Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: Do you clean up after a sewage backup?
items.preview: We fix the plumbing. A restoration company handles cleanup.
items.answer: We clear the line, find the cause and make the repair. For removing water, drying and sanitizing finished spaces, a restoration company is the right call, and we can work alongside them.

items.q: Why does my floor drain back up in heavy rain?
items.preview: Your line or the public sewer can't keep up.
items.answer: Either your line is partly blocked, or the public sewer is overloaded and pushing back. A camera inspection tells you which.

items.q: Will homeowners insurance cover a sewer backup?
items.preview: Often only with a specific rider.
items.answer: Many policies need a sewer backup rider. Ask your agent before the next storm.

items.q: How do I prevent another backup?
items.preview: Keep the line clear and add protection.
items.answer: Keep the line clear with [sewer maintenance](/hinsdale/sewer-maintenance), and add a backflow valve or overhead sewer if storms are the trigger.

items.q: How much does sewer backup service cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what caused the backup and how we reach the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
